Data extraction: YAML block sequence emits Sequence nodes

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"ports:
  - 8080
  - 8081
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"data_extraction":true,"language":"yaml"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
}
```
